say:3:1410439001:0.text: Don't hurt him! He's not like the others!
say:3:1410439001:0.source_cn: 不要伤害凯登！他是个好孩子！

say:4:1410439002:0.text: Stay where you are! He's already transformed! If you get too close—
say:4:1410439002:0.source_cn: 别过来！他已经孽化了！为了你们的安全——

say:5:1410439003:1.text: This is your fault! First Bethwyn, now Caiden!
say:5:1410439003:1.source_cn: 都是你们的错！是你们害的！先是贝丝薇，又是凯登！

say:6:1410439004:1.text: You're holding a weapon. Are you planning to cut him down like the others?!
say:6:1410439004:1.source_cn: 你拿着武器，要做什么？是不是要斩下他们的头颅！

say:10:1410439006:1.text: We've given everything to Sal'thorin! Our blood, our lives... only to be cast aside the moment we stumble!
say:10:1410439006:1.source_cn: 我们为萨洛克兰付出了很多！不……我们付出了一切！然而这...

say:11:1410439007:0.text: Ceron's right! The nobles hoard knowledge and resources. We fight and struggle, hoping to climb higher, only to be crushed for the slightest mistake!
say:11:1410439007:0.source_cn: 索伦说的没错！知识和资源被贵族们垄断，我们拼尽全力爬到...

say:12:1410439008:0.text: Generation after generation, we live in fear of corruption, trapped in a cycle we can never break! Is this our destiny?
say:12:1410439008:0.source_cn: 世世代代重复着所谓的命运，时时刻刻面临着孽化产生的风险...

say:13:1410439009:0.text: I understand your pain. I was one of you once... I know how it feels.
say:13:1410439009:0.source_cn: 诸位，我了解你们的痛苦。我也同样是平民出身……

say:14:1410439010:0.text: But right now, we have to stop the spread of corruption. Please, step aside!
say:14:1410439010:0.source_cn: 但现在最重要的是阻止孽化蔓延，请让开！

say:15:1410439011:0.text: Enough! How long are we supposed to endure this?!
say:15:1410439011:0.source_cn: 我受够了！我们凭什么要承受这些？

say:17:1410439012:1.text: Caiden's fate today is ours tomorrow! Don't let them take him! We won't let these so-called guards execute another one of our own!
say:17:1410439012:1.source_cn: 凯登的今日就是我们的明天！拦住他们，不能再让这些刽子手...
